info.bio: Con un comienzo contundente y cerebral, Ride comenzó su andadura a finales de los ochenta, posteriormente vendría el lanzamiento del single "Ride" y más tarde su primer LP "Nowhere" (1990). Considerado dentro del panorama indie como uno de los discos más importantes, como pudiera ser "Loveless", "Giant Steps", etc... con sonidos que bailaban entre el Noise y el Shoegaze muy cuidadosamente producido, hasta algún tema de Dreampop de una densidad asombrosa.

scenes.name: Psicodelia británica de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: La edad de oro de la psicodelia británica no fueron los sesenta sino los noventa: las raves crean una demanda inagotable de música inducida por (o para) las drogas. La versión pop (Telescopes, Inspiral Carpets, Verve, Sundial, Auteurs, Kula Shaker), las más sofisticadas (Curve, Cranberries, Rollerskate Skinny, Beta Band, dEUS, Gorky's Zygotic Mynci), el space-rock libre (Porcupine Tree, Terminal Cheesecake, Heads), los últimos shoegazers (Ride, Swervedriver, Spectrum y E.A.R. de Sonic Boom, Spiritualized de Jason Pierce, Flying Saucer Attack, encuentro de shoegazing y ambient) y el dream-pop (Lush, Pale Saints, Slowdive, Catherine Wheel, Bark Psychosis).

podcast.title: Discovery by Creation Records
podcast.body: A demo tape from Ride reached Jim Reed of The Jesus and Mary Chain, who, impressed by the material, passed it along to Alan McGee, the head of Creation Records. This led to Ride being signed by the influential label. "One of their demo tapes reached Jim Reed of the Jesus and Mary Chain, who liked it enough to pass it along to Alan McGee, the head of creation records, the chain's label."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Formation and Sound Aspiration
podcast.body: Formed in Oxford in 1988, the band aimed to emulate The Smiths but with a significantly louder and fuzzier sound, described as "How Soon Is Now on steroids." This blend of melodic sensibility with amplified noise positioned them firmly within the nascent shoegaze movement. "Ride came together in 1988, and they wanted to be the Smiths, only a lot louder and fuzzier."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Influence on "Smeared"
podcast.body: Ride, a "noisy pop" band on Creation Records, was a significant influence on the sound of Sloan's album "Smeared," contributing to its loud guitar aesthetic. "like my bloody Valentine and ride and all those sort of noisy pop bands that were on creation records and everything."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Sloan In Their Own Words: Part 1

podcast.title: Influence on Sigur Rós
podcast.body: Sigur Rós comes from a tradition of shoegaze groups, listing Ride as an important influence alongside My Bloody Valentine. "Siger-Rus, which means victory rose, by the way, comes from the tradition of groups into Shugays, such as My Bloody Valentine and Ride."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What Exactly is Post Rock? Part 2

podcast.title: Meteoric Rise and Decline
podcast.body: The band experienced a rapid ascent in popularity but ultimately "lost their way after a couple of years" and eventually broke up. Their trajectory mirrored the relatively short-lived initial shoegaze era. "Ride had a meteoric ride up, but lost their way after a couple of years, and broke up."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Outskirts of Britpop
podcast.body: Ride was identified as one of the "shoe-gazer bands" circling the outskirts of the Britpop universe, indicating their concurrent but distinct musical style during the era. "Circling the outskirts of this universe were shoe-gazer bands like My Bloody Valentine and Ride and Lush and Swerve Driver and Slow Dive."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Alt Rock: Chapter 12

podcast.title: Oxford Music Scene
podcast.body: Ride was one of the "big-ish Oxford bands" that the Jericho Tavern, a local venue where "On a Friday" performed a pivotal gig in October 1991, was "semi-famous" for hosting. "the Jericho Tavern, which by the way was semi-famous at the time for hosting other big-ish Oxford bands like Super Grass and Ride and Slow Dive."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Pioneer of Shoegaze
podcast.body: Ride was one of the bands that emerged between 1989 and 1991, following My Bloody Valentine's lead in developing the Shoegaze sound. They took the combination of ethereal melody and distorted guitars even further. Their career was launched by Creation Records. "En seguida, susguieron bandas como Ride, Slowdive, Feltzaint y Lash, quienes tomaron aquella combinación de melodía setéria, guitarras distorsionadas y la llevaron aún más lejos."

srcs.episode: El disco imposible: La historia de Loveless y My Bloody Valentine

podcast.title: Recommended for Fans
podcast.body: Boards of Canada is highly recommended for fans of Ride's dream pop sound. "cualquiera avante del Drimpop de ... Ride, incluso de Mokuey o de My Lord Ninjaked, va a pasarse, vamos, va a maravillarse con lo que es Borsov Canadá."
